request: Refine the sharded memory store's phase-scoped surfacing (roadmap Epic 6 T8) from coarse category-level `scope:` backfill to precise per-entry scope tags. 136 of 305 entries carry a migration default from memory-index/migrate.mjs SCOPE_BY_CATEGORY (87 landmarks -> [scout], 49 landmines -> [scout,spec,tdd,security,integrate], 47 -> any), so a docs/scout/** write surfaces 145 facts and a docs/specs/** write surfaces 107, of which process_lifecycle_guard names only 15. Narrow scope per entry and make /memory-flush narrow on re-verify rather than inherit the category default.
novelty_evidence: docs/roadmap-execution-plan.md:118 (Epic 6 T8, the only open roadmap task) and .claude/memory/backlog/scope-backfill-coarse-refine-per-entry-2902.md. Both name the same defect: memory-index/migrate.mjs SCOPE_BY_CATEGORY tagged whole categories rather than entries. Measured on this tree at HEAD 2bf79ef via surfaceScopedMemory(): scout 145 hits, spec 107, security 62, against a 15-line INDEX_CAP in process_lifecycle_guard.mjs:123.
track_reason: Leaner than intake-full because T8 and the backlog entry already state the problem, and this session measured the surface; an intake would restate it. Heavier than tdd-quickfix because the narrowing mechanism is an open design fork (bulk re-curation vs lazy-on-re-verify vs derived from `governs:` globs) that the user deferred to /spec, and tdd-quickfix would commit to one by writing the test first.
